title: New parental leave and wellness benefits
title_vi: Chế độ nghỉ thai sản và phúc lợi sức khỏe mới
lines: Good morning, everyone. This is Karen Liu from Human Resources with a quick update on our employee benefits.
Starting January first, we're expanding our parental leave program.
All new parents, regardless of gender, will now receive sixteen weeks of fully paid leave, up from ten weeks.
We're also launching a new wellness benefit.
Every full-time employee will get a monthly allowance of fifty dollars to spend on gym memberships, fitness classes, or mental health apps.
Part-time staff will receive half that amount, so twenty-five dollars a month.
To use the allowance, simply keep your receipts and submit them through the HR portal by the last Friday of each month.
We know you'll have questions, so we're holding two information sessions next week.
The first one is on Tuesday at noon in the main cafeteria, and the second is on Thursday at four in Conference Room B.
Lunch will be provided at the Tuesday session.
Before then, please take a few minutes to read the benefits guide that we emailed this morning.
If anything is unclear, feel free to reach out to me directly. Thanks, and have a great day.

questions.q: What is the announcement mainly about?
questions.vi: Người nói giới thiệu "a quick update on our employee benefits" (nghỉ thai sản + phúc lợi sức khỏe). "cafeteria" chỉ là nơi họp, là bẫy.

questions.q: How much will part-time staff receive each month?
questions.vi: "Part-time staff will receive half that amount, so twenty-five dollars a month." Bẫy: 50 đô là mức của nhân viên toàn thời gian.

questions.q: Where will the Thursday session take place?
questions.vi: "the second is on Thursday at four in Conference Room B". Bẫy: "main cafeteria" là buổi thứ Ba.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do before the sessions?
o: Read a document sent by email
questions.vi: "please take a few minutes to read the benefits guide that we emailed" = đọc tài liệu gửi qua email. "receipts" là bước dùng phụ cấp hàng tháng, không phải việc cần làm trước buổi họp.

title: Sprint retrospective summary
title_vi: Tổng kết buổi retrospective của sprint
lines: Right, thanks everyone for joining. I'll keep this short and summarise what came out of yesterday's sprint retrospective.
First, the good news: we delivered eleven of the twelve stories we committed to, which is our best result this quarter.
The one we didn't finish, the payment export feature, has been carried over to the next sprint.
On the downside, a lot of you mentioned that code reviews were taking too long.
Some pull requests sat for three days before anyone looked at them.
So going forward, we're trying a new rule: every pull request should get a first review within one working day.
Tomas has kindly agreed to set up a Slack reminder that pings reviewers automatically.
Another point was that our stand-ups were regularly running over fifteen minutes.
Well, I've timed myself, and I'm not innocent either.
From Monday, we'll move any detailed discussion to a separate thread after the stand-up.
Finally, please add your estimates for the new backlog items by end of day Thursday, so we can plan properly on Friday morning.
Any questions, just give me a shout.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.vi: Người nói tóm tắt "sprint retrospective", nói về stories, pull requests, stand-up → người điều phối nhóm phần mềm (scrum master). Bẫy: "payment export" không liên quan tài chính.

questions.q: What has Tomas agreed to do?
questions.vi: "Tomas has kindly agreed to set up a Slack reminder that pings reviewers automatically" = thiết lập nhắc nhở tự động. Bẫy: "Review all pull requests" dùng lại từ trong bài.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "I'm not innocent either"?
o: To admit he also made meetings run long
To deny a complaint about reviews
To explain why a story was unfinished
To apologize for missing a deadline
questions.vi: Sau khi nói stand-up hay quá 15 phút, "I've timed myself, and I'm not innocent either" = thừa nhận chính anh cũng làm họp kéo dài.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do by Thursday?
questions.vi: "please add your estimates for the new backlog items by end of day Thursday" = gửi ước lượng cho việc mới. Bẫy: họp lập kế hoạch là sáng thứ Sáu.

title: Morning traffic and weather
title_vi: Giao thông và thời tiết buổi sáng
lines: Good morning, it's seven fifteen, and here's your traffic and weather update on City Radio.
If you're heading into the city on the Northern Highway, expect delays of around twenty-five minutes.
A truck has broken down near Exit 12, and two of the three southbound lanes are closed.
Crews are on the scene, but they don't expect to clear it before eight thirty.
So if you can, take Riverside Drive instead; it's moving freely at the moment.
Commuters on the Bay Line trains, good news: services are back to normal after yesterday's signal fault.
Now, the weather. It's a cool fourteen degrees right now, climbing to around twenty-two by the afternoon.
But don't let the sunshine fool you.
A band of heavy rain is moving in from the west and should hit the city around five o'clock, just in time for the evening rush.
The weather bureau has also issued a wind warning for coastal areas from six tonight.
We'll have another update at seven forty-five, right after the news.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.vi: "here's your traffic and weather update on City Radio" → người dẫn chương trình radio. Bẫy: "truck", "Bay Line trains", "weather bureau" đều xuất hiện trong bài nhưng không phải người nói.

questions.q: What are drivers advised to do?
questions.vi: "take Riverside Drive instead" = đi đường khác (paraphrase). Bẫy: "eight thirty" là giờ dự kiến dọn xong xe hỏng; tàu Bay Line chỉ được thông báo đã chạy lại, không được khuyên.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "don't let the sunshine fool you"?
o: To suggest the temperature will drop sharply
To warn that the weather will change later
questions.vi: Ngay sau đó là "A band of heavy rain ... should hit the city around five o'clock" → cảnh báo thời tiết sẽ xấu đi sau đó. Bẫy: nhiệt độ thực ra tăng lên 22 độ.

questions.q: When will the rain most likely reach the city?
questions.vi: "should hit the city around five o'clock". Bẫy số: 7:45 là bản tin kế tiếp, 8:30 là giờ dọn đường, 6 giờ tối là cảnh báo gió.

title: Employee of the Year award
title_vi: Trao giải Nhân viên của năm
lines: Good evening, everyone, and thank you all for coming to our annual company dinner.
Now it's my great pleasure to present this year's Employee of the Year award.
This year's winner is Priya Sharma from our customer success team.
Priya joined us just three years ago, and she has already made a huge difference.
Last spring, she created a new onboarding program for our clients.
Thanks to her work, customer complaints dropped by forty percent.
She also trained over twenty new team members this year, always with patience and a smile.
Her colleagues describe her as the person everyone goes to when there's a problem.
As a thank-you, Priya will receive a bonus and an extra five days of paid vacation.
She'll also get a reserved parking spot for the next twelve months.
Priya, please come up to the stage to accept your award.
Everyone, let's give her a big round of applause.

questions.q: Where is the speech being given?
questions.vi: "thank you all for coming to our annual company dinner" → tiệc tối của công ty. Bẫy: "trained" và "clients" có trong bài nhưng không phải địa điểm.

questions.q: What did Priya create?
questions.vi: "she created a new onboarding program for our clients" = chương trình cho khách hàng mới. Bẫy: "complaints", "parking" xuất hiện ở ý khác.

questions.q: By how much did customer complaints decrease?
questions.vi: "customer complaints dropped by forty percent". Bẫy số: 3 năm làm việc, 20 người được đào tạo, 12 tháng chỗ đỗ xe.

questions.q: What will Priya most likely do next?
questions.vi: "Priya, please come up to the stage to accept your award" → cô ấy sẽ lên sân khấu. Bẫy: "vacation" là phần thưởng, không phải việc làm ngay.

title: Parking garage repairs
lines: Hello, this message is for Mr. Daniel Ortiz in suite 410. This is Fiona Clarke, the building manager at Harbour Tower.
I'm calling to give you a heads-up about some repairs in the underground car park.
Starting next Monday, the fifth, contractors will be repairing cracks in the concrete on levels B1 and B2.
The work should take about two weeks, weather permitting.
During that time, those two levels will be completely closed.
I know that's not ideal, especially since your team uses six of the spaces on B2.
We've arranged temporary parking at the City Centre garage on Elm Street, about a five-minute walk away.
There's no charge for tenants; you'll just need to show a visitor pass at the entrance.
I can have passes ready for your team, but I need the names and licence plate numbers of everyone who'll be parking there.
Could you email that list to me by Wednesday?
If you have any questions, you can reach me on extension 225. Thanks very much.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the message?
o: To notify a tenant about repairs
To report damage to a car
questions.vi: "I'm calling to give you a heads-up about some repairs in the underground car park" = báo trước cho người thuê về việc sửa chữa.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "I know that's not ideal"?
o: To apologize for a billing error
To explain why the work was delayed
To suggest the listener move offices
To acknowledge an inconvenience for the listener's team
questions.vi: Hai tầng bị đóng hoàn toàn và "your team uses six of the spaces on B2" → cô thừa nhận việc này gây bất tiện cho nhóm của người nghe.

questions.q: How much will the temporary parking cost tenants?
questions.vi: "There's no charge for tenants" = miễn phí. Bẫy số: 6 là số chỗ đỗ, 225 là số máy lẻ.

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the listener to do?
questions.vi: "I need the names and licence plate numbers ... Could you email that list to me by Wednesday?" = gửi thông tin người lái. Bẫy: "Wednesday" là hạn gửi email, không phải gọi lại; B1 cũng bị đóng.

title: Webinar opening
title_vi: Mở đầu hội thảo trực tuyến
lines: Hi everyone, and welcome to today's webinar, Scaling Cloud Infrastructure on a Budget. I'm Liam Walker, and I'll be your host.
We've got just over three hundred people joining from twelve countries, so thanks for being here, wherever you are.
Before we dive in, a few housekeeping notes.
Everyone's microphone has been muted to keep the background noise down.
If you've got a question, please type it into the Q&A box rather than the chat, because the chat moves pretty fast and things get lost.
Here's the plan for the next ninety minutes.
Our first speaker, Dr. Nina Patel, will talk for about forty minutes on cost monitoring tools.
After that, we'll take a ten-minute break, and then our second speaker will walk you through a real migration case study.
We'll save the last twenty minutes for your questions.
Oh, and I've been asked this already, so I'll say it now: yes, you'll get the slides.
A recording and the slide deck will be emailed to all registered attendees within forty-eight hours.
Okay, without further ado, let's bring in Nina.

questions.q: What is the webinar mainly about?
o: Cutting the cost of cloud systems
questions.vi: Tên webinar "Scaling Cloud Infrastructure on a Budget" → mở rộng hạ tầng cloud với chi phí thấp (paraphrase). Bẫy: "twelve countries", "migration" chỉ là chi tiết phụ.

questions.q: How long will Dr. Patel speak?
questions.vi: "Dr. Nina Patel, will talk for about forty minutes". Bẫy số: 90 là cả buổi, 10 là giải lao, 20 là phần hỏi đáp.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "I've been asked this already"?
o: To address a common concern in advance
To complain about too many questions
To ask attendees to stop using the chat
questions.vi: Anh nói vậy rồi trả lời luôn "yes, you'll get the slides" → giải đáp trước một thắc mắc nhiều người có. Không có ý phàn nàn.

questions.q: What will most likely happen next?
o: A case study will be presented
A speaker will begin her talk
Attendees will take a short break
questions.vi: "let's bring in Nina" → Dr. Nina Patel (nữ) sẽ bắt đầu nói. Bẫy: case study và giải lao diễn ra sau; slides gửi trong 48 giờ.

title: Weekend electronics sale
title_vi: Khuyến mãi đồ điện tử cuối tuần
lines: This weekend only, we're having a huge sale on office electronics.
All printers and scanners are thirty percent off.
Wireless keyboards and mice are buy one, get one free.
And if you're setting up a home office, don't miss our laptop deals in aisle seven.
Selected laptops are two hundred dollars off the regular price.
Members of our TechMart Rewards program get an extra ten percent off at the register.
Not a member yet? Signing up is free and only takes a minute at the customer service desk near the main entrance.
The sale ends Sunday at six p.m., so don't wait.
Also, today only, our technicians are offering free laptop setup with any laptop purchase.
Thank you for shopping at TechMart, and have a great day.

questions.q: Where is the announcement being made?
questions.vi: "Attention, shoppers! Welcome to TechMart" + khuyến mãi đồ điện tử → trong cửa hàng điện tử. Bẫy: "office" là loại sản phẩm (office electronics).

questions.q: What discount is offered on printers?
questions.vi: "All printers and scanners are thirty percent off". Bẫy: 10% dành cho thành viên, 200 đô cho laptop, mua 1 tặng 1 cho bàn phím/chuột.

questions.q: What are shoppers who are not members encouraged to do?
o: Register at the customer service desk
Ask for a discount at the register
questions.vi: "Not a member yet? Signing up is free ... at the customer service desk" = đăng ký tại quầy dịch vụ khách hàng. Bẫy: "register" (quầy thu ngân) là nơi thành viên được giảm thêm.

questions.q: What is available today only?
questions.vi: "today only, our technicians are offering free laptop setup". Bẫy: các ưu đãi khác kéo dài cả cuối tuần; đăng ký thành viên luôn miễn phí.

title: Merger announcement
lines: Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining this town hall, both here in London and online.
I'll get straight to the point. This morning, our board approved a merger with Brightline Analytics.
Many of you know Brightline; they're based in Manchester and they're one of the strongest data analytics firms in the country.
Together, we'll have around two thousand employees and offices in five countries.
I want to be clear about one thing: this is about growth, not cost-cutting.
We are not planning any layoffs as part of this deal.
The merger is expected to close by the end of March, pending regulatory approval.
Until then, it's business as usual. Please keep serving your clients exactly as you do today.
I also know news travels fast, so please don't discuss the deal with clients or the press until our public announcement on Thursday.
Your managers will hold team meetings tomorrow to answer your questions in more detail.
And of course, my door is always open.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the talk?
questions.vi: "our board approved a merger with Brightline Analytics" → hai công ty hợp nhất (paraphrase "merger"). Bẫy: Manchester là trụ sở của Brightline, không phải nơi chuyển đến.

questions.q: What does the speaker emphasize about the merger?
o: It will not result in job losses
It has already received regulatory approval
questions.vi: "We are not planning any layoffs" = không cắt giảm nhân sự. Bẫy: "not cost-cutting" (ngược với đáp án 1); việc phê duyệt của cơ quan quản lý vẫn đang chờ ("pending").

questions.q: When is the merger expected to be completed?
questions.vi: "expected to close by the end of March". Bẫy: "tomorrow" là họp nhóm, "Thursday" là công bố chính thức.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do?
o: Keep the news confidential for now
Attend a press event on Thursday
questions.vi: "please don't discuss the deal with clients or the press until our public announcement" = giữ bí mật tạm thời. Bẫy: "Inform clients" ngược nghĩa.

title: Password and two-factor policy
title_vi: Chính sách mật khẩu và xác thực hai lớp
lines: Hi all, it's Megan from the IT security team, with a reminder about the policy changes we announced last month.
From the fifteenth, all passwords must be at least fourteen characters long, up from eight.
You'll also be required to change them every ninety days rather than every sixty.
So, longer passwords, but fewer changes; it's not all bad news.
The bigger change is two-factor authentication.
Every account that can access customer data must have it switched on by the end of this month.
After that, accounts without it will be locked automatically, and you'll need to raise a ticket to get back in.
We recommend using the Authenticator app rather than text messages, since it's more secure and works without phone signal.
Setup takes about five minutes, and there's a step-by-step guide on the intranet.
If you'd rather have someone walk you through it, we're running drop-in sessions on Wednesday and Friday afternoons in room 3C.
And please don't share your codes with anyone, including people claiming to be from IT. We'll never ask for them.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the talk?
o: To report a recent data breach
To promote a new mobile app
To remind staff of upcoming security rules
questions.vi: "a reminder about the policy changes we announced last month" → nhắc lại quy định bảo mật sắp áp dụng. Bẫy: "Authenticator app" chỉ là khuyến nghị phụ.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "it's not all bad news"?
o: To point out that one requirement is becoming less strict
To announce that the policy has been cancelled
To say passwords can now be shorter
To praise staff for following the rules
questions.vi: Mật khẩu dài hơn nhưng chỉ phải đổi "every ninety days rather than every sixty" → một yêu cầu được nới lỏng. Bẫy: mật khẩu dài hơn (14 ký tự), không ngắn hơn.

questions.q: What will happen to accounts without two-factor authentication after the deadline?
o: They will receive a text message
They will need a new password
questions.vi: "accounts without it will be locked automatically" = bị khóa (paraphrase "blocked"). Bẫy: không bị xóa; "text messages" là phương án xác thực.

questions.q: What can listeners do if they want personal assistance?
o: Download a guide from the intranet
questions.vi: "If you'd rather have someone walk you through it ... drop-in sessions on Wednesday and Friday afternoons in room 3C". Bẫy: hướng dẫn trên intranet là tự làm, không có người hỗ trợ; ticket dùng khi tài khoản bị khóa.

title: Covering a client call
title_vi: Nhờ đồng nghiệp nhận cuộc gọi khách hàng
lines: Hi Jenny, it's Mark. I hope your morning's going well.
I'm calling because I need a favor.
I've got a client call with Green Valley Foods tomorrow at ten a.m., but my flight to Chicago was moved earlier, and I'll be in the air at that time.
Would you be able to take the call for me?
It shouldn't take more than thirty minutes.
They mainly want an update on the delivery schedule for their new order.
I've put all the details in a shared folder called Green Valley, including the latest shipping dates.
Their contact is Mr. Brown, their purchasing manager. He's very friendly.
If he asks about pricing, just tell him I'll follow up by email on Friday.
Please let me know by end of day if you can do it, so I can give him a heads-up about the change.
You can text me or call my cell. Thanks so much, I owe you one.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
o: To book a flight to Chicago
To ask a colleague to take his place on a call
questions.vi: "I need a favor ... Would you be able to take the call for me?" → nhờ đồng nghiệp nhận cuộc gọi thay. Bẫy: chuyến bay đã được đặt, chỉ bị đổi giờ.

questions.q: When is the client call?
o: At the end of the day
questions.vi: "a client call with Green Valley Foods tomorrow at ten a.m." = sáng mai. Bẫy: Friday là ngày gửi email giá, "end of day" là hạn trả lời.

questions.q: What does the client mainly want to discuss?
questions.vi: "They mainly want an update on the delivery schedule". Bẫy: "pricing" chỉ được nhắc nếu khách hỏi.

questions.q: What does the speaker ask Jenny to do by end of day?
o: Tell him if she is available
questions.vi: "Please let me know by end of day if you can do it" = báo cho anh biết cô có nhận được không. Bẫy: email về giá là việc của Mark vào thứ Sáu.

title: Conference schedule changes
lines: Good morning, and welcome to day two of the Asia-Pacific Software Summit.
Before we begin, I have a few changes to today's schedule to share.
First, the keynote by Dr. Hassan, originally scheduled for nine thirty, will now start at ten, as his flight landed later than expected.
To fill the gap, we've moved the sponsor showcase forward, so you can visit the exhibition hall right after this announcement.
Second, the workshop on API design has been moved from Room 2 to the Grand Ballroom.
We've had far more sign-ups than we planned for, which is great news, but Room 2 only seats fifty.
Third, the panel discussion on AI in testing has unfortunately been cancelled.
If you registered for it, you're welcome to join any other afternoon session instead.
Lunch will be served at twelve thirty on the terrace, as planned.
The updated schedule is in the conference app, so please refresh it to see the latest version.
Thank you, and enjoy the day.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.vi: Người nói chào mừng ngày thứ hai của hội nghị và "have a few changes to today's schedule to share" → ban tổ chức sự kiện.

questions.q: Why has the keynote been delayed?
questions.vi: "his flight landed later than expected" = chuyến đi của diễn giả bị trễ. Bẫy: "far more sign-ups" là lý do đổi phòng workshop.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "Room 2 only seats fifty"?
o: To explain why a session was relocated
To announce that a session is full
questions.vi: Workshop chuyển sang Grand Ballroom vì có quá nhiều người đăng ký mà "Room 2 only seats fifty" → giải thích lý do đổi phòng.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do?
questions.vi: "The updated schedule is in the conference app, so please refresh it" = làm mới ứng dụng. Bẫy: "terrace" là nơi ăn trưa lúc 12:30.

title: Tips for remote meetings
title_vi: Mẹo họp trực tuyến hiệu quả
lines: Welcome back to Work Smarter, the podcast for people who'd rather be doing their jobs than sitting in meetings. I'm Josh.
Today's topic: running remote meetings that people actually want to attend.
Tip number one: send the agenda at least twenty-four hours ahead.
If people don't know why they're there, they won't come prepared.
Tip two: keep it small. Research suggests decisions get harder once you go past about seven people.
If someone only needs the outcome, send them the notes instead.
Tip three: cameras. Now, I'm not going to tell you to force everyone to turn them on.
But for discussions that need real decisions, do ask people to, because you'll pick up on reactions you'd otherwise miss.
And tip four, my favourite: end five minutes early.
Back-to-back calls are exhausting, and those five minutes give people a chance to grab a coffee or stretch.
After the break, I'll be talking to Sarah Kim, a manager who cut her team's meeting time in half in just three months.

questions.q: Who is the podcast most likely intended for?
questions.vi: "the podcast for people who'd rather be doing their jobs than sitting in meetings" → người đi làm chán họp (suy luận). Bẫy: "remote", "Research" có trong bài nhưng không phải đối tượng.

questions.q: According to the speaker, what should be done for people who only need the results?
o: Ask them to keep cameras off
Send them the agenda a day early
Share a written summary with them
questions.vi: "If someone only needs the outcome, send them the notes instead" = gửi bản tóm tắt. Bẫy: gửi agenda trước 24 giờ áp dụng cho người dự họp.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "I'm not going to tell you to force everyone to turn them on"?
o: To show he takes a flexible approach to cameras
To admit he dislikes video calls
To say cameras are against company policy
To suggest cameras cause technical problems
questions.vi: Anh không ép bật camera nhưng "for discussions that need real decisions, do ask people to" → quan điểm linh hoạt, tùy tình huống.

questions.q: What will listeners hear after the break?
questions.vi: "After the break, I'll be talking to Sarah Kim, a manager" = cuộc trò chuyện với một quản lý (paraphrase). Bẫy: chỉ có bốn mẹo; nghiên cứu và nghỉ uống cà phê đã nói rồi.

title: Charger recall
lines: This is an important safety announcement from VoltEdge Electronics.
We are recalling our PowerQuick sixty-five watt laptop charger, model number PQ-65.
The recall covers chargers sold between March and August of this year.
We have found that some of these chargers can overheat and, in rare cases, cause burns.
So far, we have received eight reports of overheating, but no serious injuries.
If you own one of these chargers, please stop using it immediately and unplug it.
You can check your model number on the back of the charger.
To get a free replacement, visit our website at voltedge dot com slash recall, or call our customer service line.
Replacement chargers will be shipped within ten business days.
We are very sorry for the inconvenience, and we thank you for your understanding.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the announcement?
o: To warn customers about a faulty product
questions.vi: "important safety announcement ... We are recalling our ... laptop charger" → cảnh báo khách về sản phẩm lỗi và thu hồi.

questions.q: What is the problem with the product?
questions.vi: "some of these chargers can overheat" = có thể quá nóng (paraphrase "get too hot").

questions.q: What are customers who own the charger asked to do first?
questions.vi: "please stop using it immediately and unplug it". Bẫy: "You don't need a receipt" – không cần hóa đơn.

questions.q: How soon will replacement chargers be sent?
questions.vi: "Replacement chargers will be shipped within ten business days". Bẫy số: 8 là số báo cáo, 65 là công suất (watt), August là thời gian bán.

title: Project kickoff
lines: Morning, everyone, and welcome to the kickoff for Project Atlas, our new customer self-service portal.
I'm Oliver, and I'll be the project manager from start to finish.
Let me quickly run through who's doing what.
Hana is leading the front-end team, and Raj is in charge of the back-end and the APIs.
Quality assurance will be handled by Duc's team in Hanoi, who'll start testing from the second sprint.
As for milestones, we're aiming for a working prototype by the end of February, a beta release in May, and the full launch in July.
That July date is fixed, because it's tied to the client's annual conference.
In other words, there's no room for it to slip.
Our first deadline is much closer, though.
By next Friday, I need each lead to send me a rough estimate of the effort for their area.
We'll use those numbers to finalise the plan at our review meeting the following Tuesday.
Right, let's take ten minutes for questions.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the meeting?
questions.vi: "welcome to the kickoff for Project Atlas" → khởi động dự án mới. Bẫy: "beta release", "client's annual conference" chỉ là mốc/chi tiết.

questions.q: Who is responsible for testing?
questions.vi: "Quality assurance will be handled by Duc's team in Hanoi" (QA = kiểm thử). Hana phụ trách front-end, Raj back-end.

questions.q: Why can't the launch date change?
o: The beta is planned for May
It is linked to a client event
questions.vi: "That July date is fixed, because it's tied to the client's annual conference" = gắn với sự kiện của khách hàng. Bẫy: May là mốc beta.

questions.q: What must team leads do by next Friday?
questions.vi: "By next Friday, I need each lead to send me a rough estimate of the effort". Bẫy: họp review là thứ Ba sau đó; prototype hạn cuối tháng Hai.

title: Office relocation timeline
lines: Hi everyone, quick update on the office move, since I know a lot of you have been asking.
As you know, we were originally planning to move into the new building on Parker Street on the first of June.
Unfortunately, the fit-out has run about three weeks behind, mainly because of a delay with the network cabling.
So the new move date is Monday the twenty-second of June.
Here's how it'll work. On Thursday the eighteenth, the movers will collect everything except your laptops.
That means Friday the nineteenth will be a work-from-home day for everyone.
Please pack your desk into the labelled crates by five p.m. on Wednesday the seventeenth. Crates will be handed out next week.
Personal items are your responsibility, so take anything valuable home.
Now, the new office has fewer car spaces than we have now.
So if you were thinking of driving in on the first day, you may want to reconsider.
Parking passes will be allocated by the facilities team, and I'll share the details closer to the date.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the talk?
o: To update staff on a postponed move
To announce a new network system
To explain a new parking fee
questions.vi: "quick update on the office move" và ngày chuyển bị lùi sang 22/6 → cập nhật về việc chuyển văn phòng bị hoãn. Bẫy: "network cabling" chỉ là nguyên nhân.

questions.q: What has caused the delay?
questions.vi: "mainly because of a delay with the network cabling" = lắp đặt cáp mạng bị chậm (paraphrase). Bẫy: "movers", "parking" xuất hiện ở ý khác.

questions.q: By when must employees pack their desks?
questions.vi: "pack your desk ... by five p.m. on Wednesday the seventeenth". Bẫy ngày: 18 là ngày chuyển đồ, 19 làm ở nhà, 22 là ngày chuyển chính thức.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "you may want to reconsider"?
o: To ask staff to work from home on Monday
To warn that Parker Street will be closed
To announce a new parking fee
To suggest that parking may not be available
questions.vi: Ngay trước đó: "the new office has fewer car spaces" → ngụ ý có thể không có chỗ đỗ xe nếu lái xe đến. Bẫy: ngày làm ở nhà là thứ Sáu 19, không phải thứ Hai.
